questions.text: What floor is Aizhan's dormitory room on?
questions.hint: "My room is on the fourth floor — Room 412."

questions.text: Who does Aizhan share her room with?
questions.hint: "I share it with my roommate Zarina."

questions.text: Aizhan's desk is next to the window for natural light.
questions.hint: "It is next to the window, so I have good natural light when I study."

questions.text: How many textbooks does Aizhan have this semester?
questions.hint: "I have six textbooks this semester: English, Mathematics, Physics..."

questions.text: Aizhan's grandmother made her a blue ___.
questions.hint: "That blue sweater is my favourite — my grandmother made it for me."

questions.text: Who gave Aizhan the cactus?
questions.hint: "My mother gave it to me before I left home."

questions.text: Zarina has a poster of the Altai mountains on her side of the room.
questions.hint: "Zarina has a poster of Paris on her side of the room."

questions.text: What does Aizhan do every morning before breakfast?
opts: She makes her bed and organises her desk.
questions.correct: She makes her bed and organises her desk.
questions.hint: "Every morning, I make my bed and organise my desk before breakfast."

questions.text: How many notebooks does Dias use?
questions.hint: "I write everything in one place." — Dias uses only one notebook.

questions.text: Aizhan's earphones are brand new.
questions.hint: "No, my brother Arman gave them to me." — they are not new.

questions.text: Why does Dias have a calculator in his bag?
opts: Ms. Galiya says they need it every Mathematics lesson
questions.correct: Ms. Galiya says they need it every Mathematics lesson
questions.hint: "Ms. Galiya says we need it every lesson." — calculator for Maths.

questions.text: Dias drinks two ___ of water every day.
questions.hint: "I drink two litres every day." — Dias.

questions.text: Aizhan brings apricots as a snack between classes.
questions.hint: "Here — these are apricots. Very healthy!" — Aizhan.

questions.text: Who has a timetable kept inside their bag?
questions.hint: "Look — that's my timetable. I keep it inside." — Dias.

questions.text: You are holding a book in your hand. Which is correct?
questions.hint: Holding it = near you, singular → This is my book.

questions.text: "These are my earphones" is correct English.
questions.hint: Earphones = plural, near → "These are my earphones." ✓

questions.text: Look at ___ mountains in the distance! They are beautiful. (plural, far)
questions.hint: Plural + far away → those.

questions.text: You see one chair far across the room. Which is correct?
questions.hint: One chair + far away → That chair is empty.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
questions.hint: "These" = plural → "are". Others mix singular/plural.

questions.text: On the phone, how do you introduce yourself?
questions.hint: Introducing yourself on the phone → "This is [name]."

questions.text: "What ___ those?" — "Those are my textbooks." (question word)
questions.hint: "Those" = plural → What ARE those?

questions.text: You are pointing to pens that are far from you. Choose the correct sentence.
questions.hint: Plural + far away → those pens.

questions.text: What does "essential" mean?
questions.hint: Essential = absolutely necessary. "My laptop is essential for studying."

questions.text: My room is always clean and ___. Everything has its place.
questions.hint: Tidy = clean and organised. "A tidy room means a clear mind."

questions.text: What is a "wardrobe"?
questions.hint: Wardrobe = шкаф — a large cupboard where you keep clothes.

questions.text: "Cosy" means cold and uncomfortable.
questions.hint: Cosy = warm, comfortable, and pleasant. "My room is small but cosy."

questions.text: What does "organised" describe?
opts: someone who keeps things neat and in order
questions.correct: someone who keeps things neat and in order
questions.hint: Organised = keeping everything neat, tidy, and in the right place.

questions.text: My bag is very ___. I have six textbooks and a laptop inside!
questions.hint: Heavy = тяжёлый. Opposite of light. "Your bag looks so heavy!"

questions.text: What does "natural light" mean?
opts: light that comes from the sun through a window
questions.correct: light that comes from the sun through a window
questions.hint: "My desk is next to the window, so I have good natural light when I study."

questions.text: Which word means "a piece of paper or card that shows your weekly classes"?
questions.hint: Timetable = расписание — your schedule showing when each class is.
